newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Mubarak expected in Tunis for unscheduled visit.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak expected in Tunis for unscheduled visit.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is expected to travel from Libya to Tunis on Tuesday for an unscheduled meeting with Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali, diplomats said.
Mubarak spent Monday night in Tripoli where he held talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.

It was not clear how Mubarak would travel from Tripoli to Tunisia. Security sources at the Egyptian-Libyan border on Monday said Mubarak drove his own car across the border to the eastern Libyan town of Tobruk where he took a plane to Tripoli.
A U.N. embargo bans air travel to or from Libya. The travel restrictions are aimed at forcing Libya to hand over two of its citizens wanted for the bombing of a Pan Am airliner over Scotland in 1988.

JANA said Libya and Egypt were coordinating their response to a recent announcement that European Union countries would set up a task force for intervention in the Mediterranean. Libya protested against the decision.
